title: Polished Brass Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf, 8.75-Inch Wall-Mounted Covered Two-Post Solid Brass, Allied Brass
description:
End countertop clutter and keep toilet tissue protected while adding a handy landing spot for small bathroom items in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. This wall-mounted toilet paper holder features a covered two-post design with a glass shelf above the roll to help items stay dry and organized.

- Covered design protects tissue from moisture and dust
- Glass shelf adds convenient storage right where you need it
- Concealed screw mounting keeps the installation clean and finished
- Solid brass construction for dependable daily use
- Ideal for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories; coordinate with matching Waverly Place pieces

This toilet paper holder also works as a tissue holder or toilet roll holder for guest baths and primary bathrooms. Specs: 8.75 in L x 4.6 in H x 6 in W; 6 in projection. Material: brass. Mounting type: wall mount; screw size #8 x 1 1/4". Weight capacity: 250 lb. Includes toilet paper holder and all installation hardware. Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty.
